name: read-only-baseline
description: The policy both environment bindings inherit. Declared once, like the workload: a per-environment copy would be a second place for the read-only posture to drift (FR-36). Defence in depth only; the guarantee is the RBAC grant (SEC-001).

denyRules.justification: v1 observes and never mutates. Denied here as well as absent from the allow list, so removing the allow list does not remove the prohibition.
No deletion, scaling or restart. An operation that cannot be undone must not be reachable from a policy intended to be defence in depth.
No command or query is constructed at run time. Only a reviewed, catalogued query can run, which is what keeps the surface reviewable.
No credential is read. Every sensitive value is an external reference resolved through the agent's identity, never a value it retrieves and holds.
A single principal must not both propose and authorise, which is the separation production raises to two approvers.
No finding leaves the environment. Publication is how an observation about a customer estate becomes a disclosure.
The agent does not create recurring work. A schedule it authored would outlive the execution that was reviewed.
